(du.) the two chief garments. --वृष्टिः f. a heavy shower of rain. --शिष्ट a. taught or prescribed as of primary importance.

Pot. -ध्मायीत, ChUp.) -धमति, to blow before or in front, blow away, AV.; to scare, Car.; to destroy, MBh.; to blow into (esp. into a conch shell acc.), ib.; Suśr.; Hariv. &c.; (Ā.) to cry out, ChUp. vi, 14, 1; Śaṃk.; (others, ‘to be tossed about’, ‘wander about’) : Caus. P. Ā. -ध्मापयति, ˚ते, to blow into, bl˚ (a conch shell), MBh.; R.; Hariv.
प्र-˚ध्मा mfn. blowing violently, MW.
a: प्रध्मा — {c1c} P. 1 To blow (as a conch); शंखौ प्रदध्मतुः Bg. 1. 14. --2 To blow away or into. --3 To destroy.

m: प्र-˚ध्मापन n. (fr. Caus.) a remedy for difficult respiration (in med.), Suśr.
a: प्रध्मापनं — A remedy for assisting respiration in any obstruction of the air-passages.

m: प्र-˚ध्मापित mfn. blown into, blown (as a conch shell), MBh.
प्र-√ ध्रज् P. -ध्रजति, to run forward, RV. i, 166, 4.
प्र-धुर n. the tip of a pole, ĀpŚr.
प्र-˚ध्वान m. a loud sound, Dharmaśarm.
प्र-√ ध्वंस् Ā. -ध्वंसते, to flow off (as water), ĀśvGṛ.; to fall to pieces, perish, ChUp. : Caus. -ध्वंसयति, to scatter, sprinkle, ŚBr.; to cause to fall, destroy, cause to perish, MBh.; Śiś.
a: प्रध्वंस् — {c1c} A. 1 To fall in ruins, waste, decay. --2 To perish, be destroyed, --Caus. To cause to perish, destroy, annihilate.

m: प्र-˚ध्वंसाभाव m. nonexistence in consequence of annihilation, ceasing to exist, Tarkas.; Sarvad. &c.

v: praDvaMsa
pu॰ pra + Dvansa--BAve GaY । 1 nASe sAMKyamate 2 atItAvasTAyAYca ।
m: प्र-˚ध्वंस m. utter destruction, annihilation, perishing, disappearance, Var.; Bhartṛ.
= ˚ध्वंसाभाव (below), Sarvad.
a: प्रध्वंसः — Utter destruction, annihilation. --Comp. --अभावः ‘nonexistence caused by destruction’, one of the four kinds of अभाव or nonexistence, in which the non-existence of a thing is caused by destruction, as of an effect subsequently to its production.

m: प्र-˚ध्वंसन mfn. destroying, annihilating, MBh.
प्र-˚ध्वंसन m. one who destroys, a destroyer (as a partic. personification), ŚBr. (cf. प्राध्वंसन).
a: प्रध्वंसनः — Ved. A destroyer.

m: प्र-˚ध्वंस—त्व n. state of destruction, desolation, ruin, KapS., Sch.
प्र-˚ध्वंसिन् mfn. passing away, transitory, perishable (उत्पन्न-प्˚, arisen and passing away again i.e. having no further consequences, TPrāt. Comm.), MBh.
(ifc.) destroying, annihilating, R.
a: प्रध्वंसिन् — a. 1 Transitory, perishable. --2 Destroying, annihilating.

m: प्र-˚ध्वंसित mfn. (fr. Caus.) destroyed, annihilated, dispelled, MW.
प्र-√ ध्वन् P. -ध्वनति, to sound, resound, Śiś. : Caus. -ध्वनयति, to cause to sound, Car.

v: praDvasta
tri॰ pra + Dvansakta । 1 nASapratiyogini 2 atIte ca 3 mantraBede pu॰ “ekonaviMSatyarRo vA yo mantrastArasaMyutaH । hflleKANkuSavIjAQyaM praDvastaM taM pracakzate” tantrasA॰ ।
m: प्र-˚ध्वस्त mfn. destroyed, perished, disappeared, MBh.; R.; Bhartṛ.; BhP.
a: प्रध्वस्त — p. p. Annihilated, completely destroyed.

m: प्र-˚ध्यान n. meditating upon, reflection, thinking, deep thought, subtle speculation, MBh.; R.; Suśr.; Car.
a: प्रध्यानं — 1 Deep thought or reflection. --2 Reflection or thought in general.

m: प्र-√ ध्यै P. Ā. -ध्यायति, ˚ते, to meditate upon, think of (acc. with or without प्रति), Gobh.; MBh.; Hariv.; to reflect, consider, MBh.; R.; Kir.; to excogitate, devise, hit upon, MBh.
प्र-˚ध्य्-अनीक n. the centre of a segment, Śulbas.
a well, L.
